subject: DI03009021

body.en:
Definition

A coal-fired thermal power station converts the chemical energy of coal into heat,then steam-turbine mechanical energy and finally electrical energy in a generator.

Explanation and application

  • Coal combustion heats boiler water;the turbine does not burn coal inside its blades. The steam carries energy to the turbine.
  • The turbine rotates the generator rotor;electromagnetic induction produces AC. The transformer changes voltage,not the energy source.
  • Condenser cooling rejects unavoidable heat and pump/fans consume auxiliary power. Net sent-out output is less than gross generator output.
  • Conventional coal plants generally use a Rankine-cycle steam system. Gas-turbine and combined-cycle stations are other thermal technologies,not the same coal circuit.
Why condenser?

It rejects heat,condenses exhaust steam and supports a low exhaust pressure in the designed cycle.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

કોલસા આધારિત થર્મલ સ્ટેશન કોલસાની રાસાયણિક ઊર્જાને ઉષ્મા,પછી steam turbineની યાંત્રિક ઊર્જા અને અંતે generatorમાં વિદ્યુત ઊર્જામાં ફેરવે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • કોલસાનું દહન boilerનું પાણી ગરમ કરે;turbineના bladesમાં કોલસો બળતો નથી.Steam ઊર્જા turbine સુધી લાવે છે.
  • Turbine generator rotor ફેરવે;electromagnetic inductionથી AC મળે.Transformer voltage બદલે છે,ઊર્જાનો સ્રોત નહીં.
  • Condenser coolingથી અનિવાર્ય ઉષ્મા બહાર જાય;pump/fans auxiliary power લે.બહાર મોકલાતું net output,generatorના gross outputથી ઓછું છે.
  • પરંપરાગત coal plant સામાન્ય રીતે Rankine-cycle steam system વાપરે.Gas-turbine/combined-cycle અન્ય thermal technologies છે,સમાન coal circuit નથી.
Condenser કેમ?

Heat કાઢે,exhaust steam condense કરે તથા designed cycleમાં low exhaust pressure રાખે.

body.en:
Definition

A station layout shows the functional arrangement and connections of fuel,steam,air/flue-gas,cooling and electrical equipment.

Classification / representative type

  • Basic condensing coal station;subcritical and supercritical boilers differ in pressure/steam generation,so a drum is not universal.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Coal yard,conveyors,crusher and mills prepare and deliver fuel of usable size;feeders control the coal rate.
  2. Boiler furnace and heating surfaces transfer combustion heat to water/steam;the superheater raises steam temperature above saturation.
  3. The turbine contains fixed nozzles and moving blades on a shaft,coupled to the alternator;stages extract steam enthalpy.
  4. Condenser,condensate pump,feed heaters and boiler feed pump return treated water at the required pressure.
  5. Air fans,air preheater,economiser and flue-gas cleaning equipment serve combustion,heat recovery and emissions control.
  6. Cooling-water system,switchgear,step-up transformer,protection and auxiliary supplies complete the station;instrumentation monitors safe limits.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Prepared coal enters the furnace with controlled air;combustion converts chemical energy to heat.
  2. Feedwater gains heat in the economiser and boiler;steam is superheated before entering the turbine.
  3. Steam expands through turbine stages;its enthalpy drop provides shaft work and the alternator produces electrical output.
  4. Exhaust steam condenses under low pressure;condensate and feed pumps recirculate water instead of discharging the entire steam flow.
  5. Cooling water removes condenser heat;flue gas gives up recoverable heat before treatment and chimney discharge. Ash is separately collected.
  6. Controls match fuel,air and steam to demand while protections restrict abnormal temperature,pressure and speed. Generator output passes through protected switchgear and transformer.

Applications

Large dispatchable generation where fuel,water,transport and environmental approvals are available.

Limitations and safety

Hot high-pressure steam,rotating machinery,coal dust and electrical hazards require authorised operation;diagram is explanatory only.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

સ્ટેશન layoutમાં fuel,steam,air/flue-gas,cooling તથા electrical equipmentનું કાર્ય મુજબ ગોઠવણ અને જોડાણ દર્શાવાય છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • મૂળ condensing coal station;subcritical/supercritical boilerની pressure/steam generation અલગ હોવાથી drum દરેકમાં હોતો નથી.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Coal yard,conveyor,crusher અને mill યોગ્ય કદનું fuel આપે;feeder coal rate નિયંત્રિત કરે.
  2. Boiler furnace અને heating surfaces દહનની ઉષ્મા water/steamને આપે;superheater steam temperature saturationથી વધારે કરે.
  3. Turbineમાં fixed nozzles અને shaft પર moving blades હોય;shaft alternator સાથે જોડાયેલો છે.Stages steam enthalpy ઘટાડે છે.
  4. Condenser,condensate pump,feed heaters અને boiler feed pump treated waterને જરૂરી pressure પર પરત મોકલે છે.
  5. Air fans,air preheater,economiser અને flue-gas cleaning દહન,heat recovery અને emission control કરે છે.
  6. Cooling-water system,switchgear,step-up transformer,protection તથા auxiliary supply station પૂર્ણ કરે;instrumentation safe limits દેખરેખે રાખે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. તૈયાર coal નિયંત્રિત air સાથે furnaceમાં જાય;દહનથી chemical energy ઉષ્મા બને.
  2. Feedwater economiser/boilerમાં ગરમ થાય;turbine પહેલાં steam superheat થાય.
  3. Steam turbine stagesમાં expand થાય;enthalpy dropથી shaft work અને alternatorથી વીજળી મળે.
  4. Exhaust steam ઓછા pressure પર condense થાય;pumps પાણી ફરી ફેરવે,આખો steam flow ફેંકાતો નથી.
  5. Cooling water condenser heat દૂર કરે;flue gas treatment/chimney પહેલાં recoverable heat આપે.Ash અલગ એકત્ર થાય.
  6. Controls demand મુજબ fuel,air અને steam મેળવે;protection અસામાન્ય temperature,pressure/speed રોકે.Output protected switchgear/transformerથી જાય.

ઉપયોગ

Fuel,water,transport અને environmental approval હોય ત્યાં મોટું dispatchable generation.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

ગરમ high-pressure steam,rotating machinery,coal dust અને વીજ જોખમ માટે authorised operation જરૂરી;diagram માત્ર સમજણ માટે.

body.en:
Definition

The fuel-and-ash circuit is the material path that prepares and supplies fuel to the furnace and removes solid combustion residues.

Explanation and application

  • Coal receipt→storage→crusher→mill→feeder/burner→furnace. Sorting and metal removal protect equipment;the exact arrangement depends on the coal system.
  • Bottom ash collects at the furnace bottom;fly ash is carried by flue gas and captured by electrostatic precipitators or suitable filters.
  • Conveyors or pneumatic/hydraulic handling transport ash to authorised storage/use/disposal;wet and dry arrangements are not interchangeable in every design.
  • Combustible dust,spillage and ash emissions need engineered containment and housekeeping;students do not operate fuel/ash machinery.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Fuel-and-ash circuit એટલે furnace માટે fuel તૈયાર કરીને પહોંચાડતો તથા દહનના ઘન અવશેષ દૂર કરતો material path.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Coal receipt→storage→crusher→mill→feeder/burner→furnace. Sorting/metal removal equipment બચાવે;ચોક્કસ arrangement coal system મુજબ બદલાય.
  • Bottom ash furnaceના તળિયે એકત્ર થાય;fly ash flue gas સાથે જાય અને ESP કે યોગ્ય filterમાં પકડાય.
  • Conveyor કે pneumatic/hydraulic handling ashને authorised storage/use/disposal સુધી લઈ જાય;wet/dry arrangements દરેક designમાં સમાન નથી.
  • Combustible dust,spillage અને ash emissions માટે engineered containment/housekeeping જરૂરી;વિદ્યાર્થી fuel/ash machinery ચલાવતા નથી.

body.en:
Definition

The air-and-gas circuit supplies combustion air and carries combustion products through heat-recovery and pollution-control equipment to the stack.

Explanation and application

  • FD fan supplies air;an air preheater transfers heat from outgoing gas to incoming air. A primary-air system may carry pulverised fuel.
  • Furnace gas passes heating surfaces such as superheater,economiser and air preheater in the designed order;equipment order varies by station.
  • Particle collection and,where fitted,SOx/NOx controls treat emissions. ID fan draws gas toward the chimney and helps maintain designed furnace draught.
  • A chimney provides dispersion and draught contribution;it does not eliminate pollutants. Excess air is optimised,not simply made as large as possible.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Air-and-gas circuit દહન માટે હવા પહોંચાડે અને combustion productsને heat recovery/pollution-control મારફતે stack સુધી લઈ જાય છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • FD fan હવા આપે;air preheater બહાર જતા gasની ઉષ્માથી આવતી હવા ગરમ કરે.Primary-air system pulverised fuel લઈ જઈ શકે.
  • Furnace gas design મુજબ superheater,economiser/air preheater જેવી heating surfacesમાંથી જાય;ચોક્કસ order station મુજબ બદલાય.
  • Particle collection અને fitted SOx/NOx controls emissions ઘટાડે.ID fan gasને chimney તરફ ખેંચે અને designed furnace draught જાળવે.
  • Chimney dispersion/draughtમાં મદદ કરે,pollutants દૂર કરતી નથી.Excess air optimum રાખાય,માત્ર વધારે નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

The feedwater-steam circuit recirculates the working fluid through pump,boiler,turbine and condenser;the cooling circuit removes rejected heat through a separate heat-transfer path.

Explanation and application

  • Condenser→condensate extraction pump→feed heaters/deaerator→boiler feed pump→economiser→boiler→superheater→turbine→condenser is a representative closed working-fluid route.
  • Deaeration reduces dissolved corrosive gases;feedwater treatment controls scale/corrosion. Make-up water replaces losses,not the full circulating flow.
  • Cooling water passes condenser tubes,absorbs heat and returns to a cooling tower or permitted once-through outlet. It normally does not mix with turbine condensate.
  • A cooling tower cools circulating water mainly by partial evaporation and heat/mass transfer. It is not a chimney carrying combustion smoke.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Feedwater-steam circuit working fluidને pump,boiler,turbine/condenserમાં ફેરવે;cooling circuit અલગ heat-transfer pathથી rejected heat દૂર કરે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Condenser→condensate extraction pump→feed heaters/deaerator→boiler feed pump→economiser→boiler→superheater→turbine→condenser એ representative closed working-fluid route છે.
  • Deaeration dissolved corrosive gases ઘટાડે;water treatment scale/corrosion ઘટાડે.Make-up water માત્ર losses ભરે,આખો circulating flow નહીં.
  • Cooling water condenser tubesમાંથી heat લે અને cooling tower કે permitted once-through outlet પર જાય.સામાન્ય રીતે turbine condensate સાથે ભળતું નથી.
  • Cooling tower partial evaporation તથા heat/mass transferથી પાણી ઠંડું કરે;તે combustion smokeની chimney નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Efficiency is useful energy output divided by corresponding energy input over the same boundary and time interval.

Explanation and application

  • Here station thermal efficiency ηth=shaft work/fuel heat input,and generator efficiency ηg=gross electrical energy/shaft work. Hence gross overall ηo=ηthηg. The stated boundaries prevent confusion with ideal-cycle efficiency.
  • Net sent-out efficiency subtracts auxiliary consumption before dividing by fuel heat input. Using gross output with net output in one ratio gives an incorrect comparison.
  • Use h1=turbine inlet,h2=turbine exhaust,h3=condenser outlet,h4=pump outlet. For a steady steam cycle,wt= h1−h2,wp=h4−h3,qin=h1−h4 and ηcycle=(wt−wp)/qin. Neglecting pump work must be declared.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Efficiency એટલે સમાન boundary અને સમય માટે ઉપયોગી energy outputનો અનુરૂપ energy input સાથેનો ગુણોત્તર.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • અહીં station thermal efficiency ηth=shaft work/fuel heat input અને generator efficiency ηg=gross electrical energy/shaft work.તેથી gross overall ηo=ηthηg.આ boundariesથી ideal-cycle efficiency સાથે ગૂંચવણ ટળે.
  • Net sent-out efficiencyમાં auxiliary consumption બાદ outputને fuel heat inputથી ભાગાય.Gross/net ભેળવી comparison નકરો.
  • h1=turbine inlet,h2=turbine exhaust,h3=condenser outlet,h4=pump outlet લો.Steady steam cycle માટે wt=h1−h2,wp=h4−h3,qin=h1−h4 તથા ηcycle=(wt−wp)/qin. Pump work અવગણ્યું હોય તો લખો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Assume fuel input100MW,shaft output36MW,ηg=0.97,auxiliaries3MW and coal CV25MJ/kg. Steady operation and common time basis.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Let fuel heat be Qf,shaft work W and gross electrical energy Eg:ηth=W/Qf,ηg=Eg/W. Multiply to cancel W,so ηo=Eg/Qf=ηthηg.
  2. ηth=36/100=0.36;gross output=36×0.97=34.92MW;gross overall efficiency=34.92%.
  3. Net output=34.92−3=31.92MW;net efficiency=31.92/100=31.92%.
  4. Fuel heat rate100MJ/s divided by25MJ/kg gives4kg/s=14400kg/h coal. This is a declared teaching case,not station measured performance.

Interpretation and check

All efficiencies are dimensionless;heat rate and mass rate require consistent seconds/hours and MJ/kJ.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Fuel input100MW,shaft output36MW,ηg=0.97,auxiliaries3MW તથા coal CV25MJ/kg ધારો.Steady operation/common time basis છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Fuel heat Qf,shaft work W અને gross electrical energy Eg લો:ηth=W/Qf,ηg=Eg/W.ગુણતાં W રદ થાય:ηo=Eg/Qf=ηthηg.
  2. ηth=36/100=0.36;gross output=36×0.97=34.92MW;gross overall efficiency=34.92%.
  3. Net output=34.92−3=31.92MW;net efficiency=31.92/100=31.92%.
  4. Fuel heat rate100MJ/sને25MJ/kgથી ભાગતાં4kg/s=14400kg/h coal મળે.આ ધારેલું teaching case છે,stationનું measured performance નથી.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Efficiency dimensionless છે;heat/mass rateમાં seconds/hours અને MJ/kJ consistent રાખો.

body.en:
Definition

An advantage or limitation must be judged for the same service,site and system boundary,not from fuel price alone.

Explanation and application

  • Advantages:large controllable output,established technology,site flexibility relative to dam sites,and fuel inventory that reduces immediate weather dependence.
  • The plant can provide system support with suitable controls;however startup,ramp rate and minimum stable output constrain dispatch.
  • Limitations:finite fuel,CO2 and other emissions,ash handling,water demand,transport cost and substantial rejected heat.
  • Low load increases specific fuel consumption in many units;frequent starts impose thermal stresses and maintenance costs. A coal unit is not normally the fastest peaking resource.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

ફાયદો કે મર્યાદા સમાન service,site અને system boundary માટે જોવાય,માત્ર fuel priceથી નહીં.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • ફાયદા:મોટું controllable output,સ્થાપિત technology,dam site કરતાં location flexibility તથા fuel inventoryથી તાત્કાલિક weather dependence ઘટે.
  • યોગ્ય controlsથી system support મળે;પરંતુ startup,ramp rate/minimum stable output dispatch મર્યાદિત કરે.
  • મર્યાદા:મર્યાદિત fuel,CO2/અન્ય emissions,ash handling,water demand,transport cost તથા વધારે rejected heat.
  • અનેક unitsમાં low loadથી specific fuel consumption વધે;વારંવાર startsથી thermal stress/maintenance વધે.Coal unit સામાન્ય રીતે સૌથી ઝડપી peaking resource નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Installed capacity is the sum of stated generating-unit nameplate ratings;it is a power rating in MW,not actual energy generated in MWh.

Explanation and application

  • GSECL historical operator page:Wanakbori7×210+800=2270MW;the800MW unit was commissioned13October2019.This table is a source-dated reference,not a current availability report.[1](https://www.gsecl.in/business/power-generation/)
  • Post-retirement operator figures:Ukai2×200+210+500=1110MW,Gandhinagar3×210=630MW,and Sikka2×250=500MW. The older1350/870/740MWfigures include retired units and must not be used as the corresponding post-retirement totals.[5](https://www.gsecl.in/about-us/company-profile/)
  • For examination,write station,location,fuel,MW and reference date together. Ukai is near the Tapi dam;Wanakbori is on the Mahi;Sikka is near Jamnagar;Gandhinagar is near Ahmedabad.[1](https://www.gsecl.in/business/power-generation/)
  • Before an activity report,verify current unit-wise installed/retired status with the operator/CEA;record the retrieval date. MW nameplate cannot substitute for real-time generation data.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Installed capacity એટલે દર્શાવેલા generating unitsનાં nameplate ratingsનો સરવાળો;તે MWમાં power rating છે,MWhમાં actual generation નહીં.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • GSECL historical operator page:Wanakbori7×210+800=2270MW;800MW unit13October2019એ commissioned.આ source-dated reference છે,current availability report નહીં.[1](https://www.gsecl.in/business/power-generation/)
  • Post-retirement operator figures:Ukai2×200+210+500=1110MW,Gandhinagar3×210=630MW તથા Sikka2×250=500MW.જૂના1350/870/740MWમાં retired units છે;તેમને post-retirement totals નમાનો.[5](https://www.gsecl.in/about-us/company-profile/)
  • પરીક્ષામાં station,location,fuel,MW અને reference date સાથે લખો.Ukai Tapi dam પાસે,Wanakbori Mahi પર,Sikka Jamnagar પાસે અને Gandhinagar Ahmedabad પાસે છે.[1](https://www.gsecl.in/business/power-generation/)
  • Activity report પહેલાં operator/CEAથી current unit-wise installed/retired status તપાસો;retrieval date લખો.MW nameplateને real-time generation data નમાનો.

title.en: Project.1 Thermal power station layout model
title.gu: Project.1 Thermal power stationનું Layout model

body.en:
Aim and status

Source-suggested project guide;not performed or certified.

Plan and safe method

  1. Use cardboard/printed blocks for boiler,turbine,alternator,condenser and feed pump;do not create steam or burn fuel.
  2. Mark separate coal/ash,air/flue-gas,steam/feedwater and cooling-water paths with a written colour legend.
  3. Show the turbine-generator shaft and distinguish water pipes from electrical output. Do not connect cooling water into boiler feedwater.
  4. Explain each component function and trace a complete working-fluid cycle;identify auxiliary consumption and rejected heat.
  5. Prepare a labelled drawing,materials list,method,limitations and blank observation/evidence sheet;do not claim work that has not been done.
  6. Submit actual photos/measurements only after authorised completion;write a short explanation and answer why each major component is required.

Record and evidence

Identity,date,approved equipment,drawing revision,actual observations,calculation,limitations,source links and teacher feedback remain to be filled.
body.gu:
હેતુ તથા સ્થિતિ

Source-suggested project guide છે;performed/certified નથી.

યોજના તથા Safe method

  1. Boiler,turbine,alternator,condenser/feed pumpના cardboard/printed blocks લો;steam કે fuel burning નહીં.
  2. Coal/ash,air/flue-gas,steam/feedwater તથા cooling-water paths written colour legendથી અલગ બતાવો.
  3. Turbine-generator shaft બતાવો;water pipes/electrical output અલગ રાખો.Cooling water boiler feedwaterમાં નજોડો.
  4. દરેક componentનું કામ/પૂર્ણ working-fluid cycle સમજાવો;auxiliary consumption/rejected heat બતાવો.

Task and status

Compare thermal,hydro,nuclear,solar,wind and captive paths;include component/function legends and source-specific advantages/limits.

Report plan

  1. Prepare approximately five pages with aim,scope and source/date details;use the source requirement,not invented visit evidence.

a.en: It rejects heat,condenses exhaust steam and supports a low exhaust pressure in the designed cycle.
a.gu: Heat કાઢે,exhaust steam condense કરે તથા designed cycleમાં low exhaust pressure રાખે.

a.en: No;it cools circulating water and is not the combustion-gas stack.
a.gu: નહીં;circulating water ઠંડું કરે,combustion-gas stack નથી.

a.en: Net output subtracts station auxiliaries from gross generator output.
a.gu: Gross generator outputમાંથી auxiliaries બાદ net મળે.

a.en: It preheats feedwater using recoverable flue-gas heat.
a.gu: Recoverable flue-gas heatથી feedwater ગરમ કરે.

a.en: Fly ash travels with flue gas;bottom ash collects at the furnace bottom.
a.gu: Fly ash gas સાથે જાય;bottom ash furnaceના તળિયે મળે.

q.gu: Fuel/Ash circuits component functions સાથે સમજાવો.

q.gu: Air/Flue-gas તથા Feedwater/Steam circuits/heat recovery સમજાવો.

q.en: Derive the efficiency relation and solve a declared gross/net output case.
q.gu: Efficiency relation derive કરી Gross/Net case ઉકેલો.
